native.i3c_version: Actual bus specification flavour and revision; Basic and full features/errata differ.
native.i3c_mode: SDR is the baseline mode proposal; optional HDR requires negotiated matching device capabilities.
native.i3c_implementation: Actual implementation, not inferred from industry. MCU defaults and electrical limits apply only to their named devices.
native.i3c_configuration_phase: Factory proposal versus actual configured installation. SDK factory settings are not confirmed peer facts.
native.i3c_role: Actual active controller, secondary controller, I3C target or legacy target; one active clock owner.
native.i3c_bus_kind: Actual pure versus legacy mixed bus. Mixed requirements cannot be inferred from an industry name.
native.i3c_controller_id: Actual canonical active controller identity; handoff changes ownership explicitly.
native.i3c_capability_source: Actual matching GETCAPS/BCR/DCR/GETMXDS support and optional mode negotiation.
native.i3c_binding_source: Actual controller/target ports, bus segment and unique assigned addresses.
native.i3c_physical_source: Actual voltage, driver, keeper/pull-up, capacitance, stubs and edge timing proof.
native.i3c_schedule_source: Actual initialization, address arbitration, IBI, handoff, retries, transfer layout and deadlines.
native.i3c_transaction_source: Actual per-mode command/register/content-protocol, padding/integrity and transfer bound.
native.i3c_clock_source: Actual clock register/divider and measured/configured phase clocks, not maximum wire data rate.
native.i3c_pp_clock_hz: Actual Push-pull SDR/data-phase clock. Phase rates and protocol overhead are separate; no universal operating default.
native.i3c_od_clock_hz: Actual Open-drain address/arbitration phase clock. Phase rates and protocol overhead are separate; no universal operating default.
native.i3c_legacy_clock_hz: Actual Legacy I2C target phase clock. Phase rates and protocol overhead are separate; no universal operating default.
native.i3c_initial_clock_hz: Actual First broadcast disabling spike filters clock. Phase rates and protocol overhead are separate; no universal operating default.
native.i3c_initial_header: First broadcast normally uses Fm/Fm+ timing. Faster/omitted header requires actual spike-filter evidence.
native.i3c_initial_filter_source: Actual all-target accurate-filter or no-filter evidence; no automatic omission of first broadcast.
native.i3c_lanes: Actual negotiated data lanes; SDR multilane belongs to full I3C, not Basic.
native.i3c_hdr_supported: Actual matched controller-target support for selected HDR mode, not capability of a different part.
native.i3c_scl_drive: Actual clock drive: SDR controller push-pull; mode-specific clock handoff requires actual capability.
native.i3c_sda_phase: Actual phase-specific SDA drive; OD arbitration/address is separate from PP data.
native.i3c_target_stretch: I3C targets and compatible legacy targets cannot stretch SCL; controller low extension is different.
native.i3c_legacy_filter_50ns: Actual legacy target 50ns spike filter, required for supported mixed buses.
native.i3c_legacy_controller_present: Legacy I2C controllers cannot share an I3C bus.
native.i3c_legacy_mode: Actual compatible legacy Fast/Fast+ target mode, not Standard/HS/UFm.
native.i3c_direction: Actual private/CCC/legacy transfer direction; no generic Ethernet duplex.
native.i3c_address_method: Actual dynamic assignment method. SETDASA/SETAASA need static addresses; Hot-Join needs ENTDAA.
native.i3c_dynamic_address: Actual unshifted 7-bit unique target address. Broadcast/Hamming neighbours and legacy conflicts are excluded.
native.i3c_static_address: Actual optional legacy/static 7-bit address; pure I3C targets need not have one.
native.i3c_address_purpose: Ordinary dynamic address or explicitly proven legacy exception; not automatic0x0A.
native.i3c_address_source: Actual assignment and conflict-free address allocation, excluding R/W/parity bits.
native.i3c_no_legacy_hs: Actual absence of conflicting legacy HS targets, needed for exceptional03/04 addresses.
native.i3c_no_legacy_10bit: Actual absence of conflicting legacy10-bit address prefix, needed for78/79/7B.
native.i3c_no_legacy_device_id: Actual absence of conflicting legacy DeviceID use, needed for7D.
native.i3c_pid: Actual48-bit provisional device ID for ENTDAA, unique identity/arbitration; no vendor placeholder.
native.i3c_bcr: Actual8-bit BCR device capability register, not factory placeholder.
native.i3c_dcr: Actual8-bit DCR device capability register, not factory placeholder.
native.i3c_tsco_ns: Actual target turnaround. Older limits12ns and v1.2 limit20ns differ; larger values need limitation/private agreement.
native.i3c_bcr_speed_limited: Actual BCR limitation bit advertised by target.
native.i3c_maxrd_tsco_code: Actual GETMXDS maxRD turnaround field; private agreement uses code7.
native.i3c_tsco_source: Actual target datasheet/private turnaround agreement and revision-qualified measurement definition.
native.i3c_read_low_ns: Actual controller read low duration must exceed turnaround plus SDA edge and setup budget.
native.i3c_read_propagation_ns: Actual extra target-to-controller propagation/layout delay, not default zero.
native.i3c_read_setup_ns: Actual receiver setup budget at least3ns per public timing guidance.
native.i3c_read_sda_edge_ns: Actual target SDA rise/fall budget for read sampling.
native.i3c_max_read_bytes: Actual negotiated meaningful-data limit; absent is unbounded by protocol, not65535-byte default. HDR padding is separate.
native.i3c_max_write_bytes: Actual negotiated meaningful-data limit; absent is unbounded by protocol, not65535-byte default. HDR padding is separate.
native.i3c_length_source: Actual accepted SETMRL/SETMWL and content-protocol minimum/rejected-value policy; no universal minimum.
native.i3c_ccc_scope: Actual broadcast versus directed command namespace; support/content depends on version.
native.i3c_ccc_code: Actual common command byte; unknown optional/reserved commands require explicit matching revision and capability.
native.i3c_ccc_source: Actual command/defining-byte/sub-command format, target support and version/errata.
native.i3c_ccc_defining_byte: Actual optional command-specific defining byte, not generic payload header.
native.i3c_hot_join: Actual supported/enabled Hot-Join, reserved request address02 is not an assigned target.
native.i3c_ibi_data_supported: Actual BCR support for IBI with data; then first byte is mandatory data byte.
native.i3c_ibi_bytes: Actual IBI meaningful data bytes, including mandatory data byte when data supported.
native.i3c_ibi_source: Actual IBI capability/data format, maximum rate, arbitration and acceptance bounds.
native.i3c_handoff: Actual enabled secondary-controller role handoff, not I2C multicontroller arbitration.
native.i3c_handoff_source: Actual handoff/DEFTGTS/GETACCCR capabilities, current owner and latency.
native.i3c_reset_action: Actual target-reset action differs from HDR exit and address reset.
native.i3c_recovery_source: Actual reset/recovery/IBI retry and error policy with peer support and bounded schedule.
native.i3c_retry_limit: Actual software/device retry budget; protocol does not promise universal completion.
native.i3c_hdr_padding_bytes: Actual mode/lanes-specific padding; DDR CRC includes pad, HDR-BT CRC excludes last-block pad.
native.i3c_hdr_crc_policy: Actual mode integrity framing; never ordinary CAN CRC or universal packet overhead.
native.i3c_hdr_termination_crc: Actual negotiated ENDXFER CRC-on-early-termination; initial/new-version default disabled, older peers may not support it.
native.i3c_timing_control: Actual optional timing capability; Basic1.0 absent, later Basic Async0 only.
native.i3c_timing_control_source: Actual timestamp/ODR/context capability, selected revision and functional acceptance.
native.i3c_kernel_clock_hz: Actual STM32 kernel clock, strictly more than2x SCL, not inferred from peripheral type.
native.i3c_period_cycles: Actual integer STM32 SCL period in kernel clock cycles;96MHz/8 gives12MHz, not12.5.
native.i3c_bus_cap_pf: Actual total line capacitance and device/board operating constraints;50pF typical is not a universal maximum.
native.i3c_vdd_v: Actual I/O voltage and device/board operating constraints;50pF typical is not a universal maximum.
native.i3c_od_low_ns: Actual od_low_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_initial_high_ns: Actual initial_high_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_od_high_ns: Actual od_high_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_od_digital_high_ns: Actual od_digital_high_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_od_sda_rise_ns: Actual od_sda_rise_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_od_sda_fall_ns: Actual od_sda_fall_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_od_setup_ns: Actual od_setup_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_start_ns: Actual start_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_stop_ns: Actual stop_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_bus_free_ns: Actual bus_free_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.

native.i3c_pp_low_ns: Actual pp_low_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_pp_digital_low_ns: Actual pp_digital_low_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_pp_high_ns: Actual pp_high_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_pp_digital_high_ns: Actual pp_digital_high_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.
native.i3c_scl_rise_ns: Actual scl_rise_ns; qualified PIC18Q20 table limit only, not a universal I3C/default measurement.

validation.suite: full_parameter_audit + standard_defaults + profile_semantics + capacity_can_schedule + parameter_review + required_parameters + physical_profiles + serial_parameter_validity + unverified_technology_capacity + communication_dimensioning

not_certified: Public MIPI FAQ and exact vendor documents support declared rules, not full-version normative conformance; complete specification/errata and peer datasheets remain required
Microchip online tables require exact device PDF comparison; these declarations are qualified proposals/constraints, not board measurements
Actual voltage/keeper/pull-up/drive/edge/capacitance/stub/turnaround and phase clocks require hardware evidence; STM32 and PIC limits do not transfer to arbitrary chips
Full SDR/HDR/ML codecs, parity/CRC/state-machine execution, actual DAA/IBI/handoff/recovery schedule, correlated E2E safety and capacity remain MODEL_MISSING
Actual address uniqueness, negotiated lengths/rejected values/CCC formats and revision-dependent capability register semantics require canonical device evidence
